title: Polarity Swarm
core_verb: Shoot enemies while dodging bullet patterns, switching polarity to absorb same-colour bullets.
fantasy: A lone ship breaking through a scrolling gauntlet of coloured bullets to a final guardian.
fail_state: Your ship is destroyed when hit by a bullet of the opposite polarity.
win_state: Destroy the guardian by reducing its health to zero after the approach.

interaction_tags.meaning: Opposite-polarity bullet; contact destroys the ship.
Optional collectible dropped by enemies that adds score.
The end-of-approach boss; reducing its health to zero wins.

notes: The stage is reduced to a single scrolling approach ending in one guardian; polarity-switch absorption is the signature twist carried in the verb. ProjectileWeaponSystem, ProjectileManager and WaveSpawnDirector cover the shooting loop; bullet density is the main acceptance performance risk.

scene.description: A top-down scrolling corridor of starfield and drifting wreckage, coloured bullet patterns filling the screen, a guardian waiting at the end. Score orbs float where enemies fell. Dense with fire, sparse on cover: dodging is the only defence.
